That balance feels right. The overstuffed potato card is trimmed down on the surface — the giant title stops at two lines, the description at three, the long address is visually shortened, and it shows the first few labels with a "+5" for the rest — so it sits neatly in line with its neighbors instead of towering over them and throwing the whole grid off. My collection stays scannable, which is the whole point of the card view for me.

The important part is your assumption that this is only about the display: the full title, the complete description, the whole address, and all my labels are still saved and come back in full when I open it to edit. As long as nothing is actually being thrown away — just tidied for the shelf — I'm happy with that. This is good.
